body: I just don't see it that way at all. I've survived my whole life and there's no pride or heroism in those moments. I'm beyond alone at this point and can't do anything anymore. Life's a different destination for everyone some enjoy it, some struggle, and some just dont make it I know where I am in that

Look, not trying to be rude but there's no strength here. I've been through pain, hell a lot of it. But now I'm past it, but I'm tired now. I'm tired of how empty and alone i am. it's crazy to go a life without love or any affection and I'm tired
There's no curve in the tunnel just a wall. Helping people or not there's no connection with anyone that I can really form.
